title: संविधान र कानुनले व्यवस्था गरेकै समयमा निर्वाचन गरौँ : प्रचण्ड
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टीका संयोजक पुष्पकमल दाहाल ‘प्रचण्ड’ ले आगामी निर्वाचन स्वच्छ, निष्पक्ष, धाँधलीरहित र पारदर्शी हुनुपर्नेमा जोड दिएका छन् । निर्वाचन आयोगले आयोजना गरेको राष्ट्रिय मान्यता प्राप्त राजनीतिक दलहरूसँगको छलफलमा आफ्नो धारणा राख्दै उनले मतदाताले निर्वाध रूपमा मतदान गर्न पाउने वातावरण सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने बताएका हुन् । प्रचण्डले विगतका निर्वाचनमा मतगणना, मतपरिणाम र मतपेटिका व्यवस्थापनलगायतका विषयमा विभिन्न प्रश्न तथा गुनासा उठ्ने गरेको उल्लेख गर्दै आगामी निर्वाचनमा त्यस्ता समस्या दोहोरिन नदिन निर्वाचन आयोगको विशेष ध्यान जानुपर्ने बताए । उनले विगतका निर्वाचनमा कतिपय उम्मेदवारले आफ्नो मत हराएको, आफूले अपेक्षा गरेभन्दा फरक मतपरिणाम आएको तथा उम्मेदवारका प्रतिनिधिलाई मतपेटिका ओसारपसारका क्रममा सहभागी हुन नदिएको जस्ता गुनासा गरेको स्मरण गराए । आगामी निर्वाचनमा यस्ता प्रश्न उठ्ने अवस्था आउन नदिन निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया थप पारदर्शी र विश्वसनीय बनाउनुपर्ने उनको भनाइ थियो । प्रचण्डले गएको निर्वाचन सामान्य परिस्थितिमा सम्पन्न नभएको उल्लेख गर्दै लोकतन्त्रको निरन्तरता र संविधान कार्यान्वयनलाई गति दिन विभिन्न राजनीतिक दल तथा नेताहरूले विशेष भूमिका खेलेको बताए । निर्वाचनमा प्राप्त मत र जित-हार मात्र नभई लोकतन्त्रको निरन्तरता तथा संस्थागत विकासका लागि राजनीतिक दल र नेताहरूले निर्वाह गरेको भूमिकाको पनि मूल्याङ्कन हुनुपर्ने धारणा राखे । निर्वाचनको समयतालिकाबारे बोल्दै प्रचण्डले संविधान र कानुनको व्यवस्थाभित्र रहेर निर्वाचन गर्नु उपयुक्त हुने बताए। स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन वैशाखभित्र र प्रदेशसभाको निर्वाचन मङ्सिरमा गर्ने गरी निर्वाचन आयोगले प्रस्तुत गरेको समयतालिका उपयुक्त देखिएको उल्लेख गर्दै उनले यस विषयमा पार्टीभित्र थप छलफल र अध्ययन गरेर अन्तिम धारणा बनाउने बताए । त्यसैगरी, विदेशमा रहेका नेपाली नागरिकको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने विषयलाई उनले विशेष प्राथमिकताका साथ उठाए। शान्ति सम्झौतापछि पहिलो संविधानसभाको निर्वाचनको समयदेखि नै आफूले विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने धारणा राख्दै आएको उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न प्राविधिक र कानुनी दुवै पक्षमा गम्भीर अध्ययन आवश्यक रहेको प्रचण्डको भनाइ थियो । यसका लागि नेपालीहरूको ठूलो सङ्ख्या रहेका देशका सरकारसँग नेपाल सरकारले द्विपक्षीय वार्ता र संवाद गर्नुपर्ने तथा निर्वाचन आयोगले पनि आवश्यक सहजीकरण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न सके मात्रै निर्वाचनको विश्वसनीयता र नेपाली जनताको वास्तविक निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार थप सुदृढ हुने उनको धारणा थियो। निर्वाचन दुई चरणमा गर्ने विषयमा भइरहेको छलफलका सम्बन्धमा भने उनले आयोगको प्रस्तुति र सुझावलाई अध्ययन गरी पार्टीभित्र छलफल गरेपछि थप निर्णय लिने बताए। Kathmandu. Nepali Communist Party Coordinator Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda' has emphasized that the upcoming elections should be clean, fair, rigged-free and transparent. Expressing his views in a discussion with nationally recognized political parties organized by the Election Commission, he said that an environment should be ensured where voters can cast their votes freely. Prachanda said that various questions and complaints have been raised in past elections regarding vote counting, vote results, and ballot box management, and that the Election Commission should pay special attention to prevent such problems from recurring in the upcoming elections. He recalled that in past elections, some candidates had complained about losing their votes, the results being different from what they expected, and the candidates' representatives not being allowed to participate in transporting ballot boxes. He said that the election process should be made more transparent and credible to prevent such questions from arising in the upcoming elections. Prachanda said that the last election was not held under normal circumstances and that various political parties and leaders played a special role in accelerating the continuation of democracy and the implementation of the constitution. He opined that not only the votes received and the wins and losses in the election but also the role played by political parties and leaders for the continuation of democracy and institutional development should be evaluated. Speaking about the election schedule, Prachanda said that it would be appropriate to hold the election within the provisions of the constitution and the law. Stating that the schedule presented by the Election Commission to hold the local level elections within Baisakh and the provincial assembly elections in Mangshir seems appropriate, he said that a final opinion will be formed after further discussions and studies within the party on this issue. Similarly, he raised the issue of ensuring the voting rights of Nepali citizens living abroad with special priority. He said that he has been of the opinion that the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad should be ensured since the first Constituent Assembly election after the peace agreement. Prachanda said that serious studies are needed on both technical and legal aspects to ensure the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad. For this, he said, the Government of Nepal should hold bilateral talks and dialogue with the governments of countries with a large number of Nepalis, and the Election Commission should also provide necessary facilitation. He believed that the credibility of the election and the real decision-making power of the Nepali people would be further strengthened only if the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad could be ensured. Regarding the ongoing discussions on holding the election in two phases, he said that further decisions will be taken after studying the commission's presentation and suggestions and discussing them within the party.

उपयुक्त हुने बताए। स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन वैशाखभित्र र प्रदेशसभाको निर्वाचन मङ्सिरमा गर्ने गरी निर्वाचन आयोगले प्रस्तुत गरेको समयतालिका उपयुक्त देखिएको उल्लेख गर्दै उनले यस विषयमा पार्टीभित्र थप छलफल र अध्ययन गरेर अन्तिम धारणा बनाउने बताए । त्यसैगरी, विदेशमा रहेका नेपाली नागरिकको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने विषयलाई उनले विशेष प्राथमिकताका साथ उठाए। शान्ति सम्झौतापछि पहिलो संविधानसभाको निर्वाचनको समयदेखि नै आफूले विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने धारणा राख्दै आएको उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न प्राविधिक र कानुनी दुवै पक्षमा गम्भीर अध्ययन आवश्यक रहेको प्रचण्डको भनाइ थियो । यसका लागि नेपालीहरूको ठूलो सङ्ख्या रहेका देशका सरकारसँग नेपाल सरकारले द्विपक्षीय वार्ता र संवाद गर्नुपर्ने तथा निर्वाचन आयोगले पनि आवश्यक सहजीकरण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न सके मात्रै निर्वाचनको विश्वसनीयता र नेपाली जनताको वास्तविक निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार थप सुदृढ हुने उनको धारणा थियो। निर्वाचन दुई चरणमा गर्ने विषयमा भइरहेको छलफलका सम्बन्धमा भने उनले आयोगको प्रस्तुति र सुझावलाई अध्ययन गरी पार्टीभित्र छलफल गरेपछि थप निर्णय लिने बताए। Kathmandu. Nepali Communist Party Coordinator Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda' has emphasized that the upcoming elections should be clean, fair, rigged-free and transparent. Expressing his views in a discussion with nationally recognized political parties organized by the Election Commission, he said that an environment should be ensured where voters can cast their votes freely. Prachanda said that various questions and complaints have been raised in past elections regarding vote counting, vote results, and ballot box management, and that the Election Commission should pay special attention to prevent such problems from recurring in the upcoming elections. He recalled that in past elections, some candidates had complained about losing their votes, the results being different from what they expected, and the candidates' representatives not being allowed to participate in transporting ballot boxes. He said that the election process should be made more transparent and credible to prevent such questions from arising in the upcoming elections. Prachanda said that the last election was not held under normal circumstances and that various political parties and leaders played a special role in accelerating the continuation of democracy and the implementation of the constitution. He opined that not only the votes received and the wins and losses in the election but also the role played by political parties and leaders for the continuation of democracy and institutional development should be evaluated. Speaking about the election schedule, Prachanda said that it would be appropriate to hold the election within the provisions of the constitution and the law. Stating that the schedule presented by the Election Commission to hold the local level elections within Baisakh and the provincial assembly elections in Mangshir seems appropriate, he said that a final opinion will be formed after further discussions and studies within the party on this issue. Similarly, he raised the issue of ensuring the voting rights of Nepali citizens living abroad with special priority. He said that he has been of the opinion that the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad should be ensured since the first Constituent Assembly election after the peace agreement. Prachanda said that serious studies are needed on both technical and legal aspects to ensure the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad. For this, he said, the Government of Nepal should hold bilateral talks and dialogue with the governments of countries with a large number of Nepalis, and the Election Commission should also provide necessary facilitation. He believed that the credibility of the election and the real decision-making power of the Nepali people would be further strengthened only if the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad could be ensured. Regarding the ongoing discussions on holding the election in two phases, he said that further decisions will be taken after studying the commission's presentation and suggestions and discussing them within the party.

Prachanda said that various questions and complaints have been raised in past elections regarding vote counting, vote results, and ballot box management, and that the Election Commission should pay special attention to prevent such problems from recurring in the upcoming elections. He recalled that in past elections, some candidates had complained about losing their votes, the results being different from what they expected, and the candidates' representatives not being allowed to participate in transporting ballot boxes. He said that the election process should be made more transparent and credible to prevent such questions from arising in the upcoming elections. Prachanda said that the last election was not held under normal circumstances and that various political parties and leaders played a special role in accelerating the continuation of democracy and the implementation of the constitution. He opined that not only the votes received and the wins and losses in the election but also the role played by political parties and leaders for the continuation of democracy and institutional development should be evaluated. Speaking about the election schedule, Prachanda said that it would be appropriate to hold the election within the provisions of the constitution and the law. Stating that the schedule presented by the Election Commission to hold the local level elections within Baisakh and the provincial assembly elections in Mangshir seems appropriate, he said that a final opinion will be formed after further discussions and studies within the party on this issue. Similarly, he raised the issue of ensuring the voting rights of Nepali citizens living abroad with special priority. He said that he has been of the opinion that the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad should be ensured since the first Constituent Assembly election after the peace agreement. Prachanda said that serious studies are needed on both technical and legal aspects to ensure the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad. For this, he said, the Government of Nepal should hold bilateral talks and dialogue with the governments of countries with a large number of Nepalis, and the Election Commission should also provide necessary facilitation. He believed that the credibility of the election and the real decision-making power of the Nepali people would be further strengthened only if the voting rights of Nepalis living abroad could be ensured. Regarding the ongoing discussions on holding the election in two phases, he said that further decisions will be taken after studying the commission's presentation and suggestions and discussing them within the party.

मान्यता प्राप्त राजनीतिक दलहरूसँगको छलफलमा आफ्नो धारणा राख्दै उनले मतदाताले निर्वाध रूपमा मतदान गर्न पाउने वातावरण सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने बताएका हुन् । प्रचण्डले विगतका निर्वाचनमा मतगणना, मतपरिणाम र मतपेटिका व्यवस्थापनलगायतका विषयमा विभिन्न प्रश्न तथा गुनासा उठ्ने गरेको उल्लेख गर्दै आगामी निर्वाचनमा त्यस्ता समस्या दोहोरिन नदिन निर्वाचन आयोगको विशेष ध्यान जानुपर्ने बताए । उनले विगतका निर्वाचनमा कतिपय उम्मेदवारले आफ्नो मत हराएको, आफूले अपेक्षा गरेभन्दा फरक मतपरिणाम आएको तथा उम्मेदवारका प्रतिनिधिलाई मतपेटिका ओसारपसारका क्रममा सहभागी हुन नदिएको जस्ता गुनासा गरेको स्मरण गराए । आगामी निर्वाचनमा यस्ता प्रश्न उठ्ने अवस्था आउन नदिन निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया थप पारदर्शी र विश्वसनीय बनाउनुपर्ने उनको भनाइ थियो । प्रचण्डले गएको निर्वाचन सामान्य परिस्थितिमा सम्पन्न नभएको उल्लेख गर्दै लोकतन्त्रको निरन्तरता र संविधान कार्यान्वयनलाई गति दिन विभिन्न राजनीतिक दल तथा नेताहरूले विशेष भूमिका खेलेको बताए । निर्वाचनमा प्राप्त मत र जित-हार मात्र नभई लोकतन्त्रको निरन्तरता तथा संस्थागत विकासका लागि राजनीतिक दल र नेताहरूले निर्वाह गरेको भूमिकाको पनि मूल्याङ्कन हुनुपर्ने धारणा राखे । निर्वाचनको समयतालिकाबारे बोल्दै प्रचण्डले संविधान र कानुनको व्यवस्थाभित्र रहेर निर्वाचन गर्नु उपयुक्त हुने बताए। स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन वैशाखभित्र र प्रदेशसभाको निर्वाचन मङ्सिरमा गर्ने गरी निर्वाचन आयोगले प्रस्तुत गरेको समयतालिका उपयुक्त देखिएको उल्लेख गर्दै उनले यस विषयमा पार्टीभित्र थप छलफल र अध्ययन गरेर अन्तिम धारणा बनाउने बताए । त्यसैगरी, विदेशमा रहेका नेपाली नागरिकको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने विषयलाई उनले विशेष प्राथमिकताका साथ उठाए। शान्ति सम्झौतापछि पहिलो संविधानसभाको निर्वाचनको समयदेखि नै आफूले विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्ने धारणा राख्दै आएको उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न प्राविधिक र कानुनी दुवै पक्षमा गम्भीर अध्ययन आवश्यक रहेको प्रचण्डको भनाइ थियो । यसका लागि नेपालीहरूको ठूलो सङ्ख्या रहेका देशका सरकारसँग नेपाल सरकारले द्विपक्षीय वार्ता र संवाद गर्नुपर्ने तथा निर्वाचन आयोगले पनि आवश्यक सहजीकरण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। विदेशमा रहेका नेपालीहरूको मतदान अधिकार सुनिश्चित गर्न सके मात्रै निर्वाचनको विश्वसनीयता र नेपाली जनताको वास्तविक निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार थप सुदृढ हुने उनको धारणा थियो। निर्वाचन दुई चरणमा गर्ने विषयमा भइरहेको छलफलका सम्बन्धमा भने उनले आयोगको प्रस्तुति र सुझावलाई अध्ययन गरी पार्टीभित्र छलफल गरेपछि थप निर्णय लिने बताए।
